headline: Torrent Pharmaceuticals completes amalgamation of J. B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals; allots 4.19 crore shares
sum: Torrent Pharmaceuticals has allotted 4,19,22,416 fully paid-up equity shares to eligible shareholders of J. B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited as record date consideration under the Scheme of Amalgamation. The allotment completion marks the final step in the regulatory and operational integration of the two pharmaceutical entities.
detail: On 17 July 2026 (record date), Torrent Pharmaceuticals allotted 4,19,22,416 fully paid-up equity shares to eligible shareholders of J. B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation. The allotment, intimated to NSE on 20 July 2026, represents the completion of the scheme's share-based consideration structure. This merger combines two significant players in the Indian pharmaceutical sector and is governed by the amalgamation scheme as approved by the NCLT and sanctioned under the Companies Act, 2013. The transaction reflects the consolidation trend in mid-cap pharma.
